```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)
library(survival)
```

```{r}
set.seed(189)

n <- 600
age <- round(runif(n, 25, 80))
severity <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.35)  # 1 = severe, 0 = non-severe
site <- sample(c("Urban", "Town", "Rural"), n, replace = TRUE)

# Programme uptake depends on age, severity and site
site_effect <- c(Urban = 0.7, Town = 0, Rural = -0.7)
p <- plogis(-1.2 + 0.05 * (age - 50) + 1.5 * severity + site_effect[site])
trt <- rbinom(n, 1, p)

# Simulate event times and administrative censoring at day 180
event_time <- rexp(n, rate = 0.004 * exp(
  0.02 * (age - 50) + 0.8 * severity - 0.35 * trt
))

d <- data.frame(
  trt, age, severity, site,
  time = pmin(event_time, 180),
  event = as.integer(event_time <= 180)
)

head(d)
d <- tibble::as_tibble(d)
d$trt <- as.character(d$trt)
```

# Practice A: Fit a propensity-score model in R

- Who is more likely to enter the program?
  - Old people
  - And?
    - Particular sites
- What does the dataframe have?

```{r}
fit_glm <- glm(
  trt ~ age + severity + site, data = d |> dplyr::mutate(trt = as.integer(trt)),
  family = binomial()
)
d$ps <- predict(fit_glm, type = "response")
```

```{r}
trt_col_vec <- c("0" = "dodgerblue", "1" = "orange")
p <- ggplot(aes(x = trt, y = ps), data = d) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = trt), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_jitter(aes(col = trt), alpha = 0.75, height = 0) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = trt_col_vec) +
  cowplot::theme_cowplot() +
  cowplot::background_grid(major = "xy") +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white")
  )
path_p <- "_tmp/p-exp-ps.png"
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = path_p,
  plot = p,
  units = "cm",
  height = 10,
  width = 10
)
```

## part b

```{r}
d <- d |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ipw_weight_ate = ifelse(trt == 0, 1/(1-ps), 1/ps),
    ipw_weight_att = ifelse(trt == 0, ps/(1-ps), 1)
  )
d |>
 dplyr::group_by(trt) |>
 dplyr::arrange(trt, dplyr::desc(ipw_weight_ate)) |>
 dplyr::slice(1:3) |>
 dplyr::ungroup()
```

## part c

```{r}
d |>
  dplyr::group_by(trt) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    observed = dplyr::n(),
    effective_ate = sum(ipw_weight_ate)^2 / sum(ipw_weight_ate^2),
    effective_att = sum(ipw_weight_att)^2 / sum(ipw_weight_att^2),
    loss_prop_ate = 1 - effective_ate / observed,
    loss_prop_att = 1 - effective_att / observed
    )
```

## part d

```{r}
d |>
  dplyr::group_by(trt) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    prop_severely_ill_raw = sum(severity == 1) / dplyr::n(),
    prop_severely_ill_ate = sum(ipw_weight_ate * (severity == 1)) / sum(ipw_weight_ate), 
    prop_severely_ill_att = sum(ipw_weight_att * (severity == 1)) / sum(ipw_weight_att)
  )
```

## part e

```{r}
#fit a Kaplan-Meier and plot it 
fit <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ x, data = aml) 
plot(fit, lty = 2:3) 
legend(100, .8, c("Maintained", "Nonmaintained"), lty = 2:3) 
     
```

```{r}
km_curv <- survival::survfit(
  survival::Surv(time = time, event = event) ~ trt, weights = ipw_weight_ate,
  data = d
)
path_p_km <- "_tmp/km.png"
png(path_p_km, res = 300, height = 1000, width = 1000)
plot(km_curv)
dev.off()

km_180 <- summary(km_curv, times = 180)
d_km <- data.frame(
  arm = km_180$strata,
  survival_180 = km_180$surv
)
(d_km[2, 2] - d_km[1, 2]) * 100
```

```{r}
km_curv <- survival::survfit(
  survival::Surv(time = time, event = event) ~ trt,
  data = d
)
path_p_km <- "_tmp/km-unweight.png"
png(path_p_km, res = 300, height = 1000, width = 1000)
plot(km_curv)
dev.off()

km_180 <- summary(km_curv, times = 180)
d_km <- data.frame(
  arm = km_180$strata,
  survival_180 = km_180$surv

(d_km[2, 2] - d_km[1, 2]) * 100
```

```{r}
fit <- coxph(Surv(time, event) ~ trt + age + severity, data = d)

mean_survival_180 <- function(arm) {
  newdata <- d
  newdata$trt <- arm
  curves <- survfit(fit, newdata = newdata)
  mean(summary(curves, times = 180)$surv)
}
100 * (mean_survival_180("1") - mean_survival_180("0"))
```

## propensity amtching

```{r}
ps_fit <- glm(
  I(trt == "1") ~ age + severity + site,
  data = d,
  family = binomial()
  )
d$ps <- fitted(ps_fit)

m <- MatchIt::matchit(
  trt ~ age + severity + site,
  data = d,
  distance = d$ps,
  method = "nearest",
  estimand = "ATT",
  ratio = 1,
  replace = FALSE,
  caliper = 0.05,
  std.caliper = FALSE
)
summary(m)
cobalt::bal.tab(m, un = TRUE)

matched <- MatchIt::match_data(m)
```
